clue.text: Contemplate with admiration

esteem or high respect for someone

clue.text: Abridged version of 8 20 was 11 24

parts.note: 8-down is PERUSE, and an old verb meaning to study closely gives these letters

24-down is CHARGE, and a charged atom or particle gives these letters

explanation.surface: A cross-reference chain describing a shortened text.
explanation.walkthrough: The numbers point to other answers: 8 (PERUSE), 20 (HIDEAWAY), 11 (POSING) and 24 (CHARGE); each is replaced by a short synonym and the four are joined.
explanation.definitionFit: A condensed text is a shortened, abridged rendering of a longer work.

clue.text: Had up for receiving mark me well — a tanner
